Technical analysis is a method of evaluating securities by analyzing statistics generated from market data, such as past prices and volume.Five of the most common technical analysis tools include Moving Averages, Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD), Relative Strength Index (RSI), Fibonacci Retracement, and Bollinger Bands.Moving Averages (MA) is a technical analysis indicator that helps smooth out price data by creating a constantly updated average price. Its main function is to filter out the noise from random price fluctuations.Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) is a trend-following momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages of a security's price. RSI is a popular oscillator used in technical analysis that measures the speed and change of price movements.Fibonacci Retracement is a method of technical analysis that uses horizontal lines to identify areas of support and resistance.
